accessibility.accessibleNameSource: Tab text. A panel is named by its tab. Name the tab list with aria-label when the context does not.
aria: list: role=tablist and aria-orientation set as host attributes (following orientation), unless the author set a role, which is kept
tab: native button with role=tab, aria-selected, one tab stop (roving tabindex, applied to the inner button)
tab: aria-controls through the ariaControlsElements property (an element reference from a shadow root to the light DOM above it resolves; an ID would not)
panel: role=tabpanel as a host attribute, named by its tab with ElementInternals ariaLabelledByElements; where unsupported the tab text is copied into aria-label
panel: tabindex=0 so a panel with no focusable content is reachable by keyboard
references between tabs and panels (aria-controls, ariaLabelledByElements) are re-resolved whenever tabs or panels are added, removed or change value
a value that names no enabled tab (empty, unknown, disabled) selects the first enabled tab
forced colors: the selected tab of the primary variant is Highlight on HighlightText; the line variant draws its indicator in Highlight

keyboard.ArrowDown: next enabled tab in a vertical list
keyboard.ArrowLeft: previous enabled tab (next in right-to-left); wraps
keyboard.ArrowRight: next enabled tab (previous in right-to-left); wraps
keyboard.ArrowUp: previous enabled tab in a vertical list
keyboard.Tab: enters the list on the selected tab, then moves to the selected panel

accessibility.targetSize: Each tab is at least 24px high and wide enough for its text (WCAG 2.5.8).

change.note: Fires on the sb-tabs host after a person selects a different tab. Not fired for changes made from code. A change from a form control inside a panel also bubbles to the host: listen with event.target === host (that one has no detail).

openQuestions.answer: The inner button. The roving-focus controller works on the sb-tabs-trigger hosts (so retargeted key events match), and the host's tabIndex accessor forwards to its button; a tabindex on the generic host breaks the tablist/tab ownership check in axe.
openQuestions.question: Which element carries tabindex for roving focus?

contract.summary: Switches between panels of related content, one visible at a time, with a row or column of tabs. Four custom elements share state through context.

# Plan: Tabs (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-tabs`, `-list` (variant primary|line), `-trigger`, `-content`: value, orientation, automatic and manual activation, roving focus, `change`. Out of scope: scrolling overflow, closable tabs.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/tabs/Tabs.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/tabs/tabs.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/tabs/Tabs.scss` -> `Tabs.styles.ts` (generated, shared) |
| 4 | `Tabs.ts`, `TabsList.ts`, `TabsTrigger.ts`, `TabsContent.ts`, `context.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Test plan (test-first)
- Roles tablist, tab, tabpanel; names; only the selected panel displayed.
- Initial selection from `value` or first enabled; click selects; `change` detail, bubbles, composed, not for code changes.
- Keyboard: one tab stop, arrows wrap, Home/End, disabled skipped, Tab reaches the panel; manual activation; vertical orientation; right-to-left reverses.
- `aria-controls` and the panel name in the accessibility tree.
- Variants from tokens; focus ring keyboard-only; disabled; axe.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
- 3px solid focus ring; inactive tab text uses `muted-foreground` in both modes (documented drift).

## Open questions (recommendation first)
All four answered with the recommendation: tabindex on the trigger host; element references across roots with an aria-label fallback; manual activation as a prop; `value-change` event name.
